in_marathi.name: Anahvi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anahvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anahvi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Anah’ which means ‘free from sorrow’ and ‘Vas’ meaning ‘grace, serenity or calm’. The name Anahvi symbolizes the inner peace and happiness that comes from being free from mental and emotional turmoil.
